Game Title Generator

Generate video game titles by genre — fantasy, sci-fi, horror, racing, RPG, and more, with real title patterns.

📖 How to use

  1. Pick a genre.
  2. Press Generate Game Titles.
  3. Click any title to copy it.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Which genres are included?

Fantasy, Sci-Fi, Horror, Racing, RPG, Puzzle, Sports, and Mystery — each genre has its own title patterns.

How many titles per click?

8 titles per click, all unique in the batch.

Do they sound like real games?

Yes — the patterns mirror how real game titles are built ('X of Y', 'Adjective Noun', etc.).

How do I copy a title?

Click any title to copy it.
